profile.headline: Software Engineer | Leader | AWS Cloud Designer
profile.summary: As a seasoned team leader, I excel at fostering a collaborative and productive work environment founded on trust, respect, and best practices. My approach is rooted in my engineering background, which allows me to leverage my technical expertise to inspire and motivate team members to deliver their best work. With a keen understanding of the importance of team dynamics, I strive to create an inclusive, supportive environment where developers feel empowered to grow and excel. Ultimately, my goal is to build a high-performing team that works together seamlessly to achieve project goals while also realizing their individual potential.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Specializing in cloud-native architecture and Azure technologies. Expert in modernizing enterprise systems through scalable microservices, distributed computing, and innovative cloud solutions. Proven track record of designing high-performance architectures that drive digital transformation and enhance organizational technological capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Service Bus

positions.title: Director of Corporate Engineering
positions.description:
Leadership: Lead team to build superior solutions to real-time service fulfillment in a AWS Server-less strategy.

Team Culture: Cultivated a collaborative team environment based on trust and constructive feedback.
Cross Team: Maintained strong relationships with key stakeholders in product platform, finance, sales, marketing, and business intelligence

Ownership: Managed critical internal services, ensuring smooth data flows and customer provisioning.
c# (dotnet 7+): Proficient in building services and UI tools using c# and the latest .NET frameworks.
ASP.NET Development: Developed ASP.NET dashboards on ECS backends with integrated authentication via Okta.

Chat Integration: Successfully integrated Chat GPT 3.5 API (Azure OpenAI client) into the dashboard. 
Continuous Learning: Always leading the team into new areas and challenging them to learn and experiment. "Planting seeds" for future harvesting.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led Team in AWS Cloud Migration: Orchestrated the successful transition of our systems to new AWS-based infrastructure leveraging microservices, optimizing scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Designed and built out the cloud architecture including VPC, NAT Gateway, API Gateway, Lambda as well as several other services. 

Cultivated Team Maturity: Nurtured a collaborative and growth-oriented environment, enabling us the team to achieve key objectives such as scalability, separation of concerns, and elevated code quality. 
Developed New Customer Provisioning Services: Spearheaded the creation of Provisioning Services, launched in 2022, streamlining critical processes and enhancing operational efficiency.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led a Dynamic Team: Spearheaded a high-performing team, driving successful project delivery by achieving critical milestones and consistently surpassing expectations. 

Agile Methodology Implementation: Introduced and championed agile development methodologies, fostering seamless collaboration, rapid iteration, and adaptability within the team. 

Robust Software Architecture Design: Crafted and implemented resilient software architectures, ensuring scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead team that owns ECommerce integrations of product listings and online ads into major channels such as Google, Bing, Facebook, and others.

Lead the instrumentation of a time series metrics collection system base on Prometheus and Grafana that allows the business to understand the historic and current output of our processing engine in terms of data flowing through the system.

Formed a virtual team to disseminate good coding practices and standards. The team generated a new wiki site and wrote around 20+ articles, gave 5 engineering-wide presentations, and initiated several smaller projects to incrementally address code debt

Responsible for hiring of current team, implementing tougher process to weed out weak coders greatly raising the bar for our developers
positions.insights: Skills: Scalable Architecture · Cloud Infrastructure · Agile Methodologies · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Product Road Mapping · Technical Design · Team Leadership · Microservices · Customer Requirements · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Git · Technical Leadership · Technical Engineering · Communication · System Performance · Coaching · Leadership · Software Architecture · Software Development · Code Design · SQL · Debugging · Web Services API · IT Integration · English · Agile Environment · DevOps · Team Management · Data Models · Engineering Leadership · Swagger API · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Collaborative Decision-making

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description: Manage all software development for Avidian Technologies. This involved the development of the flagship product Prophet and it's evolution into a fully cloud supported back-end. Because the team was small, I was able to maintain my main passion, design and development.  During this period my team and I delivered key features including a new customer driven import of custom mapped Excel files, implementing an integrated analytics platform, building a public facing API, and numerous customizations.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Mentor other developers.  Champion best practices.  Implement new practices such as Agile Scrum, TFS, and proper code branching.  Took lead on architecture of our new Saas based CRM platform.
